notes: Version 11.33. This update makes updating itself on the Mac sturdier. The app now keeps a clearer record of what happens while an update runs, so if an update ever runs into trouble we can see exactly where it stopped instead of guessing. It also carries the sign-in piece it needs along with it, so nothing is missing after the update. Nothing else changes - signing in, the scan, the verdicts, Guided Clean and the threat list are unchanged. The phone build is 11.9.16.
